scope: Integrity of the full viable tRNA population, including isolates. Row/isolate counts are derived from pinned input, not claimed as printed paper statistics; directed mutation count is also reported in the main text.
preprocessing: Retain all 28,530 genotypes with Fit > 0.5, including 3,903 isolates; preserve source row order; use ln(Fit/0.5). Match positions 1..69 and every ordered A/C/G/T allele pair. Draw n random pairs with replacement using RandomState(n**2+3), ddof=0; mean and population SD/sqrt(828). RNG and inference are not applicable to structural counts.

sources.locator: Results, Epistasis is highly idiosyncratic, p. 1686 (PDF page 2): I_id=0.612 +/- 0.005 s.e.m.; Methods, Estimating the idiosyncrasy index, p. 1692 (PDF page 8).
01_trna/00_data/ExpData.txt and get_fitness.py; filter Fit>0.5. Positions 1..69 and all directed A/C/G/T changes. Count isolated viable genotypes without pruning them.

comparison.justification: Exact counts from the pinned input.
